dedupe_keys.name: urbreath 3 30 300 indicator rasters cluj napoca leuven madrid tallinn

description: These four datasets map the 3-30-300 urban greening rule for Cluj-Napoca, Leuven, Madrid and Tallinn: every person should see at least three trees from home, every neighbourhood should have at least 30 per cent tree canopy, and everyone should live within 300 metres of a public green space. They were published on Zenodo in late August 2025 by the URBREATH project, funded by Horizon Europe, as one record per city. Each record holds a raster of the overall score from 0 to 3, rasters for each rule (number of trees visible within 200 metres, canopy share in 20 and 30 metre buffers, and distance to green space), greenery layers derived from OpenStreetMap, and SLD styles for display. Coverage is the four cities; the Zenodo search on 2026-09-26 found no other URBREATH city. Access: open download of small GeoTIFF files. Licence: Creative Commons Attribution 4.0; free. Caveats: tree and green-space inputs partly come from OpenStreetMap and interpolation, so completeness varies, and visibility is modelled, not observed. Simulation uses are targeting tree planting and public green space for heat mitigation and equity, and heat exposure layers for adaptation planning. Related records: the Montreal 3-30-300 indicator and the Miami-Dade tree canopy statistics.
name: URBREATH 3-30-300 indicator rasters (Cluj-Napoca, Leuven, Madrid, Tallinn)
